Here are the Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes that you can read:

- **#PD-4492**: Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk SMS bay assignments not reaching drivers at Doors 14–18. Thea Ramaswell submitted it on 4 Oct 2025, and support confirmed the fix on 5 Oct. Source: `teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md` ("Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth"), under "What Changed" and "Action Items".
- **#4419**: Gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. Thea logged it, and the cheat sheet says it was escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing. Source: `teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md` ("Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)"), under "Account & Operational Notes" and "What Changed".

Two other digests mention QFL but have no ticket number: the 14 Sep 2025 North pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in.

I left out the Central handoffs digest (#4409 and #4412). Those belong to Pree's dealer account, not QFL. I also left out the 2025 handoff email that mentions #4419, since it isn't one of Moss's notes.

Your April 2026 debrief note also has #8841, but that's your own note, not Moss's, so I haven't counted it here.
